name: Thanisandra
tagline: A main-road address. Many different daily routines.
description: Thanisandra Main Road links the Nagavara side of the Outer Ring Road with the Hegde Nagar and northern residential belt. The corridor includes larger apartment communities, local retail and routes towards the Manyata employment area. Projects marketed under Thanisandra may actually sit at Hegde Nagar, Thirumenahalli or Bellahalli.
